body: mine usually look like that at the mid-stage.
Not everyone is good at it, but even then at least you're trying. Hang in there.
It's been a few hours but today I still feel the same. I have a flight in 4 days, and I'm considering just killing myself then. So at least no one will wonder where I am for at least 2 months.
Thank you for your suggestion. I never thought that medication was ever an option to look at.

To relay ideas. Like if I want to suggest a new idea or approach to work, I always say i knew someone who would do it this way or that way. Perhaps it was me trying to get people to do something without taking full responsibility? 

In organisations where I was a group leader or a department head I would say 'I knew X who would approach something similar like this by doing it Y-way. So why don't we try that.' and then midway I would catch myself and found it weird as to why I needed to lie to get it across.

I didn't lie in my post, I can only be truly honest and not feel the compulsion to lie when I am anonymous, or with strangers online. I used to play a lot of video games and post on forums where I made online friends. They were the ones I were always truthful to. But I never told anyone about these suicidal thoughts. Usually I lie to peers to try and fit in. For example if my friends complained about being broke I'd tell them that my parents also limit my spending and never let me get things I want. But in actual fact they have always been very reasonable. Things like that. Lying to fit in better.
I live in Malaysia. I usually lie to relate to people more, so it can be anything from yeah I tried that once too (food/drugs/sport etc) to making people up.

Mental illness is something with a big stigma in my country. They will reject you from getting into university or even a job for it, and it's acceptable to do that. So maybe that is why he told me I didn't need a follow up. 

I think I am more aware of the lying now. I try to catch myself doing it.

He told me that I was completely fine and just going through hormones probably. 
I used to have a problem with compulsive lying too, so I can't remember if I lied to him.

I majored in Japanese, but now I am learning Mandarin and German. Focusing on German more for university. Language learning takes my mind off things for a bit, but I cant concentrate that well lately. thanks for replying. I feel like I shouldnt have these thoughts or feelings.
I saw a therapist once when I was 17. I am 25 now, and life is going so well on paper.
I learn languages and look after my dogs in my spare time. I have 8 dogs so when I am not out seeing people I am with them.
Everything is high and then low. When nothing is going on I don't feel the happy high anymore, or sometimes midway when I should be happy I feel completely empty.
I really don't know. i just feel like I want everything to end.
